mapper.sql: id, master_id, sub_id, sku_id, qty, price, amount, actual_qty
mapper.select: SELECT oi.id, oi.sub_id AS subId, ps.product_id AS productId, oi.sku_id AS skuId, p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS productName, ps.color_name AS colorName, ps.size_name AS sizeName, oi.qty, oi.price, oi.amount FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON oi.sku_id = ps.id AND ps.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN product p ON ps.product_id = p.id AND p.is_delete = 0 WHERE oi.master_id = #{masterId} ORDER BY oi.sub_id ASC, oi.id ASC
